findings.title: Dangerous Linux capability granted
findings.description: The granted capability breaks container isolation: ALL grants everything, SYS_ADMIN is near-root, NET_ADMIN can reconfigure host networking, SYS_PTRACE can inspect host processes, and DAC_OVERRIDE bypasses file permissions. Grant only the minimal capabilities required.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Docker and CIS Docker Benchmark best practices. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, least privilege, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
